画面与真实世界: The illustration and the real world

科学互动演示，讲解与操作在画面旁边: Interactive science illustration with explanations and controls alongside
月亮为什么有圆有缺？绕着地球走一圈，同时看太空中的月球和地面上看到的月相。: Why does the Moon change shape? Follow its orbit and compare the view from space with the phase seen from Earth.
拖动时间，找一找满月。月球真的不自转吗？: Move through time to find a full Moon. Does the Moon really not rotate?
球体放大、距离压缩；右下角为北半球月相示意。拖动画面可转动视角。: Bodies enlarged and distances compressed; inset shows a Northern Hemisphere phase view. Drag to orbit.
太阳照亮月球的一半。新月时，明亮的那一半主要背对着地球，所以我们很难看见月亮。: The Sun lights half the Moon. At new Moon, the bright half faces mainly away from Earth, making the Moon hard to see.
月球走到侧面，从地球上能看到亮面的一半。月球并没有少掉一块。: With the Moon to one side of Earth, we see half of its sunlit face. No piece of the Moon is missing.
现在受太阳照亮的一面朝向地球，我们看到一轮满月。普通月相不是地球影子挡住月亮造成: The sunlit side now faces Earth, giving us a full Moon. Ordinary phases are not caused by Earth’s shadow.
月球继续前进，看到的亮面又逐渐变少。完成一次月相循环，大约需要 29.5 天。: As the Moon continues, the visible bright area shrinks again. A complete phase cycle takes about 29.5 days.
太阳—地球参考系中，月球的日照方向与观察方向夹角决定可见受光比例。新月附近该比例: In a Sun–Earth frame, the angle between illumination and viewing directions determines the visible lit fraction. Near new Moon it approaches zero.
四分之一周期处，日月在地球天空中的角距约为 90°，可见月盘约有一半受光。这里使: A quarter-cycle in, the Sun and Moon are about 90° apart in Earth’s sky and half the lunar disk is illuminated. This uses a circular-orbit approximation.
满月时日月方向近乎相反。月轨道倾角使大多数满月不发生月食；本演示不模拟食的阴影。: At full Moon the Sun and Moon are nearly opposite in the sky. Orbital inclination prevents an eclipse at most full Moons; eclipse shadows are not simulated here.
恒星月约 27.3 天，朔望月约 29.5 天。地球也在绕太阳公转，因此回到同一: The sidereal month is about 27.3 days; the synodic month is about 29.5. Earth’s motion around the Sun makes returning to the same phase take longer than one orbit relative to the stars.
金色小点标记月球朝向地球的一侧。绕行时它一直朝内：月球一边公转，也一边自转，平均: The gold dot marks the Earth-facing side. It keeps facing inward because the Moon rotates once per orbit. We mainly see the same side, but the far side also receives sunlight.
轨道和月相按几何关系演示，不是实时星历。地月大小与距离默认分开缩放；真实比例视图: Orbit and phase follow illustrative geometry, not a live ephemeris. Body sizes and distances are scaled separately by default; the true-scale view is separate. Libration, eccentricity and eclipses are omitted. Surface maps and clouds are static.
月球上的坑从哪里来？ →: Where do lunar craters come from? →
地月之间，约能排下 30 个地球: The distance is about 30 Earth diameters
真实比例排列，用来比较大小与距离，不代表当前月相的位置。: A true-scale lineup for comparing sizes and distance, not the positions for the current phase.
金色箭头表示太阳光方向: Gold arrows show the direction of sunlight
容易混淆的地方: A distinction to keep in mind
月相来自照明与观察几何: Phase is illumination and viewing geometry
太阳始终照亮月球近似一半的球面。地球上的观察者能看见多少亮面，取决于月球处的太阳: Sunlight illuminates approximately half of the lunar sphere. The illuminated fraction of the disk seen from Earth depends on the angle α between the Sun and Earth as seen from the Moon. Circular orbits and parallel sunlight give a simple geometric relation.
k 是月盘受光面积比例，α 是月球处的相位角。新月 α ≈ 180°、k ≈ 0: k is the illuminated disk fraction; α is the phase angle at the Moon. At new Moon α ≈ 180° and k ≈ 0; at full Moon α ≈ 0° and k ≈ 1. The Moon itself does not change shape.
先点新月，再点满月：同时比较金色光线、月球位置和地面月相。: Select New Moon, then Full Moon. Compare the gold sunlight arrows, the Moon’s position and the Earth-view inset.
受光面积比例不等于亮度比例；月面反射特性会影响实际亮度。普通月相也不是地球影子造: Illuminated fraction is not brightness: lunar reflectance also matters. Ordinary phases are not caused by Earth’s shadow.
朔望月为什么比恒星月长: Why the synodic month is longer
月球相对遥远恒星绕地一周约 27.32 天；这段时间地球也沿公转轨道前进。月球还: An orbit relative to distant stars takes about 27.32 days. Earth advances around the Sun during that time, so the Moon must travel farther to recover the same Sun–Earth–Moon alignment. The phase cycle is about 29.53 days.
T_syn 为朔望月，T_sid 为恒星月，T_year 为恒星年；各周期须采用: T_syn is the synodic month, T_sid the sidereal month and T_year the sidereal year, all in the same units. This mean-angular-speed relation omits month-to-month variations.
从新月播放到下一次新月，留意下方显示的月相周期天数。: Play from one new Moon to the next and watch the elapsed phase-cycle days.
本视图随太阳方向转动，保持阳光从同一侧照来；因此屏幕上转一圈对应朔望月。: This view rotates with the Sun’s direction, keeping sunlight on one side. One screen revolution therefore represents a synodic month.
月球在公转时也自转，平均自转周期与恒星公转周期相等，因此主要用同一面朝向地球。早: The Moon rotates as it orbits. Its mean spin period equals its sidereal orbital period, so approximately the same hemisphere faces Earth. Tidal deformation and internal dissipation altered its early spin over a long evolution toward synchronization.
ω_spin 与 n_orbit 分别是相对惯性空间的平均自转和公转角速度。画面: ω_spin and n_orbit are mean spin and orbital angular speeds in inertial space. The gold surface marker faces Earth while changing its orientation in space throughout the orbit.
跟住金色小点走一圈：一直朝地球，不等于在太空中一直朝同一个方向。: Follow the gold marker for a whole orbit: facing Earth does not mean pointing in one fixed direction in space.
同步锁定不表示月球背面永远黑暗。真实月球有天平动，长期可见表面略多于一半。: Tidal locking does not leave the far side permanently dark. Libration lets us see somewhat more than half of the real lunar surface over time.
月食要求满月附近的月球还接近轨道交点，才能进入地球本影。月球轨道相对黄道倾斜约: A lunar eclipse requires a full Moon near an orbital node so that the Moon can enter Earth’s umbra. Its orbit is tilted about 5.1° to the ecliptic, so most full Moons do not produce eclipses. A separate true-scale view compares size and average distance.
R_M、R_E 是月球和地球的平均半径；d 是平均中心距离约 384,400 k: R_M and R_E are mean lunar and terrestrial radii; d is the mean center-to-center distance, about 384,400 km. The true-scale lineup is not a dated orbital configuration.
切换真实大小与距离：两者之间大约能排下三十个地球直径。: Switch to true size and distance: the center-to-center gap spans about thirty Earth diameters.
当前动画不计算食、轨道倾角或椭圆轨道；不能把屏幕重合直接解释为一次月食。: The animation does not calculate eclipses, orbital inclination or eccentricity; screen overlap is not evidence of an eclipse.
明亮的一面主要背对地球。从右下角看，月亮很暗；它仍然是一整个球。: Most of the lit hemisphere faces away from Earth. The inset looks dark, but the Moon is still a whole sphere.
月球继续绕行，我们开始看见一小片亮面。像月牙一样的亮边会慢慢变宽。: As the Moon moves, a thin sliver of its lit side comes into view. The crescent gradually grows wider.
月球来到地球旁边的方向，我们看见的月盘约有一半是亮的。亮的部分还在增加。: The Moon is roughly to one side of Earth and about half of its visible disk is lit. The lit portion is still growing.
现在亮的部分已经超过一半，月亮正逐渐变圆。太阳始终只照亮球面的大约一半。: More than half of the visible disk is now lit and the Moon is approaching full. Sunlight still illuminates about half of the whole sphere.
受太阳照亮的一面主要朝着地球，所以我们看到接近圆圆的月亮。普通月相不是地球影子造: Most of the sunlit hemisphere faces Earth, giving a nearly round Moon. Ordinary phases are not caused by Earth’s shadow.
月球继续走，明亮的部分开始减少。先比较满月，再看现在少掉了哪一边的亮光。: The Moon continues onward and the lit portion starts to shrink. Compare with full Moon to see which edge is becoming dark.
又能看见约半个月盘受光，但这次是另一侧亮。亮的部分还在减少。: About half of the disk is lit again, now on the other side. The illuminated part is still shrinking.
只剩一弯细细的亮边。再往前走，就会回到下一次新月，开始新的月相循环。: A thin crescent remains. Farther along the orbit, the Moon returns to new and begins another phase cycle.
平均中心距离约为 30 个地球直径: Mean center distance: about 30 Earth diameters
眼前月盘的受光比例: Illuminated fraction of the visible lunar disk
大图从太空看，小图从地球看；大小与距离为教学调整。拖动画面可转动。: Main view: from space. Inset: from Earth. Sizes and distances adjusted for teaching. Drag to orbit.
